question: Under the archived public hotel hazard field, compare distance routing, the stored author policy, current-snapshot replanning, and a full-future minimum-dose reference.
starts: Every nonexit movement cell in the archived author ordering; 61 expected

movement.common_constraint: Only legal cardinal moves; apply common legal mask to stored DQN; no wait action; revisits allowed
movement.terminal: First arrival at either graph stair-exit cell

scoring.primary: Integrate piecewise-linear public FER during each departure-cell residence interval; charge initial interval once; stop on first exit arrival; no pre-departure exposure
scoring.legacy_secondary: Author compatibility only: initial cell plus subsequent nonexit cells, floor to 5-second samples, fixed movement duration
scoring.minimum_FED_reference_objective: Reach an exit within 45 legal moves, minimize FED, break exact risk ties by fewer moves then action order
scoring.failure_handling: Report failures separately; never treat their partial FED as a successful low-dose result; pairwise outcome comparisons use jointly reached cases

methods.information: Map and current position; no gas observations or future hazard input
methods.objective: Fewest legal moves to either exit; action-order tie break

methods.information: Current position only at inference; prior training exposure and budget not independently recovered; weights unchanged
methods.objective: Stored Q argmax after applying the common legal-action mask

methods.information: Map, current position, exact current FER across all public regions; no future rows
methods.objective: Recompute minimum-dose snapshot path each movement step, treating current FER as stationary; fewer-move tie break

methods.role: privileged diagnostic reference, not online fair competitor
methods.information: Full future public FER for the entire finite horizon
methods.objective: Backward dynamic programming on time-expanded graph for minimum cumulative FED, then fewer moves

reporting.primary_results: 61 starts at the already studied 300-second departure
reporting.transfer_results: Eight other departure times, 61 starts each; same building, same fire, same checkpoint; descriptive transfer diagnostics
reporting.inferential_statistics: None; 549 start-time combinations are not 549 independent fires
reporting.safety_claim: Graph arrival and a gas-dose metric do not validate real-building evacuation safety

verification.unit_checks: Analytic linear integrals, terminal charging, tiny exhaustive-path comparison, current-snapshot behavior, horizon failure
verification.known_route_checks: Four archived routes reproduce previous same-residence and legacy FED values
verification.stored_policy_check: At 300 seconds verify all 61 paths against archived stored-policy diagnostic
verification.independent_reference_check: Forward time-expanded shortest path on four fixed starts at every departure must match backward minimum FED
verification.rollout_reference_check: Every successful evaluated route has FED >= corresponding future minimum within tolerance
